inspection_method: All48 native views shown in12 reduced diagnostic montages; original and corrected air/water asset candidate also viewed directly at native image resolution. Exact native images remain unaltered; labelled montages are derived previews.

observations.libre-air-water: Thick original circle/bars cross authored manufacturer and identity labels; trial mark also overlaps identity.
observations.libre-power: Manufacturer and tag readable in reduced views; identity partly obstructed by trial mark. Corrected views include original arrow geometry.
observations.libre-motion: Original linework crosses manufacturer and identity area; trial mark also obstructs identity.
observations.qcad-hydraulic: Original valve baseline crosses manufacturer text; trial mark obstructs identity.
observations.qcad-mechanical: Manufacturer and tag readable; original nut remains visible; trial mark obstructs identity.
observations.qcad-template: No original model geometry beyond the authored test anchor; manufacturer/tag readable; trial mark obstructs identity.

framing: First min/max-as-XYWH batch clips source geometry/disclaimer or identities. Corrected canonical model frames show full drawing context/disclaimer; asset views intentionally frame parent and fields and may clip the global disclaimer outside that frame.
verdict: No complete readability pass: inherited overlaps and/or retained trial marks obstruct content.
